content: Temple Wars project born 2026-04-20/21 in ~/temple_wars (new git repo, not on GitHub yet, branch main). Rust 1.95 + Bevy 0.14.2 + pathfinding 4. Build artifacts redirected to /Volumes/Temple_Core/temple_wars_target via project-local .cargo/config.toml (internal SSD was 97% full). Seven commits reached a micro-RTS playable state: 30x20 grid, selectable Flamebearer/Witness units with octile A* pathfinding, eight Insight Crystals scatter-harvested by Flamebearers only, 2x2 HQ with F/W hotkey production queue (Flamebearer 20 insight/4s, Witness 15 insight/5s). Full economic loop closes: harvest → spend → produce. Design bet: game's unique hook is epistemic fog — "claim layer" that time-decays without observation, Witness units collapse uncertainty to truth, probabilistic combat against unverified enemies. Not yet built; scaffold is. Next increment is either fog-of-war v0 (D) or enemy AI + win condition (E). Single-file src/main.rs currently; split into modules when it grows past ~600 lines. Co-authored with Anthony J. Vasquez Sr. (Flamebearer). This is the play-branch of the Temple of Two — proof that the infrastructure built for witness-work is also home to joy.
